algorithm: single-stage RL (SAPG) with consecutive subgoal co-tracking reward
success_criterion: Success Rate = percentage of trials completing all task stages; trial terminated on unrecoverable grasp loss or object drop
headline_metric: average Success Rate (SR) / Task Progress (TP), SharpaWave hand, 7 tasks, 15 trials/task
headline_value: TELEDEXTER 75.2%/87.1% vs. DexRT 5.7%/37.6%, GeoRT 0.0%/28.5%, DexGen 0.0%/25.0%, SimToolReal 8.9%/28.9% (Table 1)
human_data: own hand-object motion-capture data (unnamed, ~50 min per object)
note_gaps: the per-subgoal r_score equation (per-finger tip error, object position error, object rotation error terms) is an unrendered/missing block in the parsed markdown; exact formulas not recoverable
operator_interface: NOKOV motion-capture system tracking operator hand pose and object 6D pose in real time (not vision-based, not a glove)
retargeting_objective: two-stage geometry-aware retargeting: Stage 1 fingertip-vector alignment to human hand geometry; Stage 2 object-mesh-aware refinement combining a surface-contact term, a differentiable-SDF interpenetration penalty, a self-collision sphere term, and a temporal-smoothness term, producing the fingertip+object-pose subgoals the RL controller tracks
